verdict.rationale: WezTerm keeps its main user data, the configuration, in a plain-text Lua file in your home directory (or next to wezterm.exe for portable use), so it is inherently open and portable. Community users confirm they diff, sync and reuse the config across machines with chezmoi and nix. However, there is no documented export feature or statement covering all data, such as scrollback or session state. Missing for 10: documented export of scrollback/session data, an explicit data-portability or export statement covering all user data.
